data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English name Pierce, which was derived from the Latin name Percival or Percivius. This name means 'Son of Percival' or 'Son of Percivius'. Percival was a legendary knight of King Arthur's Round Table. The name became popular in England during the Middle Ages.
